description: This file defines a SwingWorker class 'CopySelectionWorker' that facilitates copying selected data from a table component to the system clipboard. It processes the selection, constructs a string representation of selected cells, and handles copy and UI cleanup operations.

classes.name: CopySelectionWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass that copies selected table data to clipboard in a background thread.

methods.name: CopySelectionWorker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker with a reference to the table.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the task of gathering selected table data and copying it to clipboard.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Performs UI cleanup after copying is completed.
